    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">如何安装claude code以及ccr code</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="如何安装claude-code以及ccr-code">如何安装claude code以及ccr code</h1>
<h2 id="1-安装-node">1. 安装 node</h2>
<h3 id="11-node的常规安装适用于linux1804linux2004等新版本">1.1 node的常规安装（适用于linux18.04，linux20.04等新版本）</h3>
<p>参考官网安装顺序：<a href="https://nodejs.org/en/download" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://nodejs.org/en/download</a></p>
<h3 id="12-常规安装失败其他情况下node的安装适用于linux1604等旧版本">1.2 常规安装失败，其他情况下node的安装（适用于linux16.04等旧版本）</h3>
<p>即选择直接安装 node的全依赖版本</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>下载全依赖版本 node：<a href="https://unofficial-builds.nodejs.org/download/release/v22.9.0/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://unofficial-builds.nodejs.org/download/release/v22.9.0/</a><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2846022/202510/2846022-20251012225627246-327336718.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>解压并重命名</p>
</li>
</ol>
<pre><code>tar -xzvf node-v22.9.0-linux-x64-glibc-217.tar.gz -C ~/node/
mv node-v22.9.0-linux-x64-glibc-217/ node-v22/
</code></pre>
<ol start="3">
<li>
<p>.bashrc中添加路径信息：<br>
export PATH="/home/****/node/node-v22/bin:$PATH"</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>修改 npm 使用阿里云镜像源:</p>
</li>
</ol>
<pre><code>npm config set registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com
</code></pre>
<h2 id="2-安装claude-code">2. 安装claude code</h2>
<p>安装好npm之后，就可以安装claude code了</p>
<pre><code>npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
</code></pre>
<h2 id="3-安装ccr-code">3. 安装ccr code</h2>
<p>安装好npm之后，就可以安装ccr code了(ccr code 全称： Claude Code Router code)</p>
<pre><code>npm install -g @musistudio/claude-code-router
</code></pre>
<p>详见项目地址：<a href="https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router/blob/main/README_zh.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/musistudio/claude-code-router/blob/main/README_zh.md</a></p>
<h2 id="4-申请魔塔社区的免费api账户">4. 申请魔塔社区的免费api账户</h2>
<p>魔塔官网：<a href="https://www.modelscope.cn/my/overview" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.modelscope.cn/my/overview</a><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2846022/202510/2846022-20251012230350390-351703037.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="5-设置ccr-code的config文件">5. 设置ccr code的config文件</h2>
<h3 id="51-进入linux的homeclaude-code-router目录">5.1 进入Linux的/home/****/.claude-code-router目录</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2846022/202510/2846022-20251012230649762-1706117354.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="52-新建或打开configjson文件输入以下内容记得替换你自己的魔塔api密钥">5.2 新建或打开config.json文件,输入以下内容，记得替换你自己的魔塔api密钥</h3>
<pre><code>{
  "LOG": false,
  "OPENAI_API_KEY": "",
  "OPENAI_BASE_URL": "",
  "OPENAI_MODEL": "",
  "Providers": [
    {
      "name": "modelscope",
      "api_base_url": "https://api-inference.modelscope.cn/v1/chat/completions",
      "api_key": "此处输入你的魔塔api密钥，密钥不带'ms-'开头",
      "models": ["Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct","ZhipuAI/GLM-4.5","deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.1","moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Instruct","openai-mirror/gpt-oss-120b","Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507"],
      "transformer": {
        "use": [
          [
            "maxtoken",
            {
              "max_tokens": 65536
            }
          ],
          "enhancetool"
        ],
        "Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507": {
          "use": ["reasoning"]
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "Router": {
    "default": "modelscope,Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct",
    "background": "modelscope,deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.1",
    "think": "modelscope,Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507",
    "longContext": "modelscope,Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct",
    "longContextThreshold": 60000,
    "webSearch": "modelscope,ZhipuAI/GLM-4.5"
  }
}

</code></pre>
<h2 id="6-启动-ccr-code">6. 启动 ccr code</h2>
<p>进入你的项目目录再执行 ccr code命令<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2846022/202510/2846022-20251012231239031-285752035.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
